scope: Default subsequent spectrum processing with first 0251 narrowing; historical results retain their actual coefficients.
variance_assumptions: Conditional counting variance; fixed per-pair width factors; extra c=1; multiplicity correlations and systematic errors separate
combined_spectrum: Sum separately subtracted groups; sum their conditional variances
input_requirement: Unsubtracted P/R counts in the same selected energy representation; per-pair alpha=Wp/WR; never subtract R again from a net spectrum.
coefficient_basis: Current explicit user instruction: all extra coefficients c=1; preserve each pair alpha=Wp/WR
historical_results: Retain the actual alpha used; do not relabel old fits or F3 as using this policy
